{{Otheruses|Naboo}}
'''Naboo''' was the [[Language/Legends|language]] of the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Human inhabitants]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It was distinct from [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].<ref name="DarthP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

[[Omar Berenko/Legends|Omar Berenko's]] [[Poet/Legends|poem]] [[Defense of Naboo/Legends|''Defense of Naboo'']] was written in Naboo. [[Cosinga Palpatine]] spoke Naboo, as did the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]].<ref name="DarthP" />
